```{r}
library(ebvcube)
library(terra)
```

## Listing all new created .nc files

```{r}
rm(list = ls())

setwd(dirname(rstudioapi::getActiveDocumentContext()$path))
root <- '../Data_geo/'

nc_files <- list.files(
  path = root,
  pattern = "\\.nc$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

# Print the list of .nc files
print(nc_files)
```

### Global properties

```{r}
plum <- ebv_properties(nc_files[4], verbose=FALSE)
print(plum)
```

```{r}
# Check slot names
slotNames(plum)
```

### Cube paths to see metric names and descriptions

```{r}
plumpaths <- ebv_datacubepaths(nc_files[4], verbose = FALSE)
plumpaths
```

### Metric properties

```{r}
plum_dc <- ebv_properties(nc_files[4], plumpaths[1,1], verbose=FALSE)
plum_dc@metric
```

### Spatio-temporal and resolution properties

```{r}
# Spatial 
cat("EPSG: ", plum@spatial$epsg, "\n")
cat("Resolution: ", plum@spatial$resolution, "\n")
cat("Extent: ", plum@spatial$extent, "\n")

# Temporal
cat("Dates: ", as.character(plum@temporal$dates))
```

### Data type

```{r}
plum_dc@ebv_cube$typ
plum_dc@ebv_cube$fillvalue
```

### Entity names

```{r}
plum <- ebv_properties(nc_files[4],  verbose=FALSE)
plum@general$entity_names
```

### Plot data for one entity and one timestep

```{r}
datacube_path <- ebv_datacubepaths(nc_files[4])
dc <- datacube_path[3,1]

start.time <- Sys.time()
data <- ebv_read(nc_files[4], dc, entity = 1, timestep = 1:2, type = 'r')
end.time <- Sys.time()

time.taken <- end.time - start.time
time.taken

plot(data)
```
